title: ShallowSID Is Moving
html: Either sync via cloud (recommended) or export and re-import your data manually.

title: Welcome to ShallowSID
html: The whole High Voltage SID Collection of C64 music, played right in your browser.
• {icon:home} Home: search by title, composer, group or year. What you play shows up here.
• {icon:library} Playlists: favorites and your own lists, also as links to share.
• {icon:settings-outline} Settings: tune SID settings, select player backend, sync between your devices, and export your playlists.
Used ShallowSID before? Bring your playlists and favorites along, or turn on sync to keep them in the cloud.
